name: Lat pulldown
notes: Cable pulldown to the upper chest.

guide.setup: Sit with thighs secured under the pad, grip the bar just outside shoulder width, and lift the chest with only a slight lean back.
guide.execution: Drive the elbows down to pull the bar to the upper chest, then return slowly to a full overhead stretch.
guide.cues: Keep ribs stacked. Pull elbows to the sides. Pull down, not behind the neck.
guide.mistakes: Pulling behind the neck; swinging far back; shrugging; stopping short of the top stretch.
